body: Ability extensibility follow-up (2026-10-09), planning only. User requires other modders to easily add new abilities with their own animations. E1: specify a discoverable, versioned ability-pack contract and no-core-edit authoring path. E2: include custom animation authoring/binding and real native collision/reaction proof. E3: require automatic integration with loadouts, controller HUD, unlocks, saves and compatibility diagnostics. E4: provide scaffolding, validation, examples, documentation and an independent clean-package authoring acceptance. Root owns planner changes and verification (running); existing combat scope remains intact. No implementation or runtime success is claimed.
